theorem_title: Relative correctness of the wanted-layout constructor
theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingWantedLayout.program_meets_relative {lim : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Limits} {μ : ℕ→ℤ} {dst cover counter h J K N NB NC d : ℕ}
    (hgroup : μ (cover+3)=(_root_.ThreeSum.LocalCoverBounds.groupSize h : ℤ))
    (hcap : μ (counter+2)=(_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.GlobalEncoding.representationCap h J : ℤ))
    (hw : (lim.space : ℤ)≤lim.word) (hd : d<lim.depth)
    (hs : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingWantedLayout.relativeSpace dst cover counter h J K N NB NC≤lim.space) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Meets lim _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingWantedLayout.program 1 d [J,h,K,cover,counter,N,NB,NC,dst] μ (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingWantedLayout.time h J)
      (fun result ν => result=((_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingWantedLayout.layout dst h J K N NB NC).work : ℤ) ∧
        _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.SegN ν dst (_root_.ThreeSum.ReportingHostWantedLayout.values (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingWantedLayout.layout dst h J K N NB NC)) ∧ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.SameOutside μ ν dst 14) := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let integer memory $\mu$ store the prescribed local group size at the cover header and representation cap at the counter header. For natural block, depth, incidence, and source-size parameters, assume addresses fit the word limit, the call depth is available, and the exact relative layout fits space. The closed layout program returns its work pointer, writes the fourteen natural layout fields at the destination, changes no cells outside that fourteen-cell record, and meets its specified time bound.

Constructs the wanted-query allocation from actual retained headers. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
